queue_order: Stable sorted node IDs within each active round; neighbors enter the next round; node-local gradient steps read the current workspace; nodes flagged by a failed global certificate take one forced step
budget_scope: All added-edge frame initialization/traversal reads, incident-edge reads and full convergence certificates; input/load/preprocessing and coordinate translations are separately counted and timed
certificate: One passing full certificate of the quiescent workspace commits. Settings.stable_sweeps is retained for C0 compatibility but unused by C1: the coordinates cannot change between repeated certificates, so R002's ten identical passes were duplicate work
fallback: disabled; exhausted updates leave saved state unchanged
initialization: Exact shared saved C0 geometry compiled from public offsets, certified and saved before every intervention; all setup/load costs charged
update_initialization: Every old component is a rigid frame and each added node a singleton frame. A stable spanning tree of added inter-frame constraints initializes frame translations, preserving old internal answers. Cycles and contradictions still use the declared residual relaxation. All frame edge reads share the dynamic cap; global translations are timed and counted. No reference/truth access.
world_variation: Each seed draws grid widths, continuous position jitter, consistent chord cycles, intervention endpoints and the contradiction vector. R001/R002 seeds only relabeled one fixed geometry per size/intervention
controls: Third disconnected component is unaffected; distant connected nodes are potentially affected, never required to remain fixed
reference: Independent sparse anchored least squares (preconditioned conjugate gradients), qualified against independent dense LS at small sizes; compiled coordinates also measured; per-case update time is compared with the faster fresh recompute
acceptance: Every result is reference-correct when committed or explicitly unresolved with byte-identical previous state; all budget, reference, retention and reload checks pass. Prior-state answers after a refusal are reported separately, never as coverage
claim_scope: 48 registered interventions, three seed-varied worlds per size/intervention; no registered effect margin, generalization or sublinear end-to-end claim
selection_rule: No tuning or adaptive selection; all cases and all unresolved outcomes are retained. Generator and certificate changes were made after inspecting R002 and are evaluated only on these new seed-varied worlds
